summary: Iteration 68: Tested Almond Guest House Management System (AGHMS) and File Upload in Parent Communication. All 40 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified Guest House dashboard, floor view, check-in flow, payment recording, and checkout. Parent Communication file upload and Parent Reception file download features working correctly.
passed_tests: Guest House dashboard shows 30 rooms, occupancy stats, revenue (GHS 1,230)
Guest House floor view shows 15 rooms per floor (3rd: 301-315, 4th: 401-415) with color-coded status
Guest House check-in flow: tap available room, fill guest details, select dates, confirm — room turns occupied
Guest House payment recording with cash/bank/mobile_money methods and receipt number
Guest House checkout: checkout guest, room returns to available
Guest House bookings tab shows active guests with outstanding amounts
Guest House all history tab shows completed bookings
Guest House accessible from Receptionist sidebar under HOSPITALITY section
Guest House accessible from Admin/SuperAdmin sidebar under OPERATIONS section
Receptionist Parent Communication has file upload (Attach Files button in compose)
Parent TCIS Reception page shows file attachments with download links in messages
Backend: /api/guesthouse/dashboard returns correct room counts (30 total)
Backend: /api/guesthouse/rooms returns 30 rooms with floor filtering
Backend: /api/guesthouse/bookings POST creates booking and updates room status
Backend: /api/guesthouse/payments POST records payment and updates booking outstanding
Backend: /api/guesthouse/bookings/{id}/checkout frees room
Backend: /api/guesthouse/analytics returns revenue stats (admin only)
Backend: /api/guesthouse/pricing returns default rate GHS 350
Backend: Room bed capacity correct (1-10: 1 bed, 11-15: 2 beds per floor)
Backend: File upload endpoint works (/api/files/upload)
Backend: Message with attachments sent successfully
Backend: Parent can view messages with attachments
Receptionist login redirects to /receptionist/dashboard
CEO login redirects to /admin/dashboard
Admin login redirects to /admin/dashboard
Parent login redirects to /parent/home
Analytics endpoint restricted to admin roles (receptionist denied)
Pricing update restricted to admin roles (receptionist denied)
Cannot change status of occupied room
Cannot checkout already checked out guest
